femticPy, vendored for scripts/prep_vulcan.py
=============================================

upstream   : https://github.com/hseille/femticPy (CSIRO, Hoel Seille; MIT licence, see LICENSE)
commit: 1b0fe316c01714d06a1c3be2bef5fa47daa67f0c
commit date: 2025-09-16  "plot_induction_arrows and read_result_csv updated (merged issues #2 and #3)"
vendored   : 2026-09-25

Copied: src/ (femticPy.py, MTtools.py, __init__.py), scripts/ (create_mesh.sh, fix_output1.py, meshGen.sh,
run_inversion.sh, run_inversion_synthetic.sh), LICENSE, README.md.
Not copied: projects/ (example data), docs/, .git.

Import normalisation: every upstream file is CRLF; each was converted to LF with  sed 's/\r$//'  and is
otherwise byte-identical to the upstream commit. The CRLF shell scripts fail under bash ($'\r': command not
found), and this repository stores text as LF (.gitattributes).

Patches: patches/series lists them in order with a one-line rationale each. They apply with 'patch -p1' from
this directory to the LF-normalised upstream files; only src/femticPy.py is patched. The working copy here
IS the patched result; the .patch files are the record. Every patched line carries a '[patch 000N]' comment
where the change is not self-evident.

  0001 write_observe frequency format %.5f -> %.6e
  0002 read_MTdata: snap near-duplicate frequencies before data_Z/data_VTF are copied
  0003 read_MTdata: snapping guard 'freq == 0' -> 'len(freq_list) == 0'
  0004 all writers: open(..., newline='\n')
  0005 MeshGen: %.10g / %d instead of %4.1f / %4.3f for table values
  0006 MeshGen: NUM_THREADS, SURF_MESH, ITER_MAX, ALTITUDE file, optional SEA_DEPTH, region lines
  0007 write_observe(owner_element=-1): dummy VTF H-stations (FEMTIC OWNER_ELEMENT -1)
  0008 write_inversion_control: BOTTOM_RESISTIVITY, OWNER_ELEMENT, %.10g for CONVERGE/TRADE_OFF/ALPHA
  0009 read_MTdata: never snap onto a band the same EDI already holds (needed once 0002 propagates snaps)

0006-0008 keep upstream behaviour at their defaults; 0001-0005 and 0009 change output formats or fix bugs.
Verified on 2026-09-25: applying the series to the LF-normalised upstream reproduces src/femticPy.py byte
for byte (cmp), and the unpatched files equal upstream with CR removed.

To reproduce:
  git clone https://github.com/hseille/femticPy.git fp && git -C fp checkout 1b0fe316c01714d06a1c3be2bef5fa47daa67f0c
  mkdir -p base/src base/scripts
  for f in src/femticPy.py src/MTtools.py src/__init__.py scripts/create_mesh.sh scripts/fix_output1.py \
           scripts/meshGen.sh scripts/run_inversion.sh scripts/run_inversion_synthetic.sh LICENSE README.md; do
    sed 's/\r$//' fp/$f > base/$f; done
  (cd base && for p in $(grep -v '^#' ../patches/series | awk '{print $1}'); do patch -p1 < ../patches/$p; done)
  cmp base/src/femticPy.py src/femticPy.py

Tested (2026-09-25) on the Vulcan EDIs and a synthetic pair of EDIs (A1 and a copy with 200 -> 200.4 Hz
and 100 -> 100.2 Hz):
  upstream      : 200.4 Hz kept as a separate band (0003); the copy's 100 Hz row dropped by prep_data (0002);
                  the 1.25e-4 Hz data of D5, E3 and F2 silently dropped (snapped in edi_data only).
  0001-0008     : synthetic case fixed, but D5, E3 and F2 get two rows at 1.26263e-4 Hz (0009's reason).
  0001-0009     : synthetic case fixed; 65 distinct bands, 1.26263e-4 Hz at 6 sites and 1.25e-4 Hz at 3,
                  no repeated frequency at any site.
None of this touches the default Vulcan selection (0.001-100 Hz), where every site holds identical values.

Known upstream issues NOT patched (scripts/prep_vulcan.py works around them):
  - MeshGen.__init__ sets the ellipsoid centre z to -median(z) with z already = -elevation, i.e. below
    ground; prep_vulcan.py sets MeshGen.center explicitly.
  - MeshGen writes the site z of mt_coords (femticPy: -elevation) into obs_site.dat and resistivity_attr.dat;
    prep_vulcan.py passes the mesh-surface z (0 for a flat surface).
  - DataGen.prep_data converts and floors data_Z in place, so a second write_observe call would convert
    twice; prep_vulcan.py calls it once per process.
  - write_observe's tipper masking test is a no-op (the conditions are always true and drop() is not
    assigned); irrelevant here because no tipper is inverted.
  - scripts/fix_output1.py and InvResults use pandas APIs removed in pandas 3 (delim_whitespace): use
    1.5 <= pandas < 3.
  - Invalid escape sequences ('\s', '\O', '\c') in regular strings raise SyntaxWarning on Python >= 3.12;
    harmless (the strings still mean what was intended).
